business_problem: ServiceNow had hundreds of complex internal processes where bottlenecks and rework were hard to spot with traditional reporting alone.
solution_summary: ServiceNow had hundreds of complex internal processes where bottlenecks and rework were hard to spot with traditional reporting alone. ServiceNow implemented a ServiceNow-centered stack built around Process Mining, Workflow Data Fabric, RaptorDB, and Now Assist. Key components included Process Mining finds bottlenecks and rework in process data; Workflow Data Fabric connects operational data and automation context; RaptorDB accelerates workflow analytics; Now Assist adds generative search, summarization, and drafting. Work enters as cases, requests, or automations, is classified or summarized by Process Mining and Now Assist, and uses context from RaptorDB before Workflow Data Fabric routes or fulfills the work. The same record of work is then exposed back to agents and end users through the platform. Running process analytics and continuous improvement on one data model reduced manual handoffs and made expansion easier.

solution_components.name: Process Mining
solution_components.role: Analyzes workflow event data to uncover bottlenecks, loops, and rework.

solution_components.name: Workflow Data Fabric
solution_components.role: Connects operational data across systems and powers automation with shared context.

solution_components.name: RaptorDB
solution_components.role: Provides fast operational analytics and data processing for workflow insights.

solution_components.name: Now Assist

business_outcome: ServiceNow cut change-management processes by 84%, discovered 74% of HR cases that needed recategorization, and uses one optimization product across about 900 processes.
metrics: 74% Of HR cases discovered for recategorization
